title_en: Premises for sale in the Kontakt complex in the area of ​​the former Partizani club near the Park.
description_en: Premises for sale in the Kontakt complex in the area of ​​the former club Partizani near the Park. The premises have a total area of ​​180 m², where in the certificate there are 59 m² units, and there are 11 tables outside, 7 inside. The daily turnover is estimated at 150-200 thousand lek per day. For sale due to emigration. Price 3000 euros/m², 180,000 euros
